thread:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert -> LATENCY_SLO_BURN (p99) for route /v1/generate. Current p99: 1.9s (SLO 1.0s). Pager: P2. Alert id: PD-987654.

PagerDuty: Alert PD-987654: page fired for eng-oncall-night. See: https://pagerduty.example/PD-987654

maya: acked and responding. Acked PD-987654 :white_check_mark:

maya: I'm looking at traces — spike started ~2143654290. Seeing KV cache saturation on gpux-03, high scheduling latency.

alex: confirming. logs from gpux-03: `batch_queue_backpressure=1.0` and `avg_inflight=4096` — not OOM but queueing.

maya: Can we failover to fallback-model (quantized) in the routing policy while we mitigate?

leo: I'll flip routing fallback to prefer fallback-model for the next 10m. Running:
```
# run from ops runbook
./routedb set-priority --route /v1/generate --add fallback-model --weight 0.8 --ttl 600
```

ops-bot: Executed by leo @2143654332: success. New routing weights applied.

maya: scale up dedicated pool (dedicated-gpu-pool-a) by +2 nodes to absorb backlog.

nina: autoscaler trying to spin new nodes; ETA ~90s. I'm also pushing a kvcache flush on gpux-03 to free mem: `curl -XPOST http://gpux-03:8080/kv/flush`

alex: flushed KV caches on gpux-03 and gpux-04. Confirming drop in mem pressure. p95 improved to 0.9s, p99 still 1.7s.

sre-rotation: what's customer impact? Any errors?

maya: No 5xx spike, mainly increased latency affecting webhooks and interactive latency for customers on dedicated tier. Estimated affected requests: ~7% of traffic, mostly long-context workloads.

alex: hypothesize cause: continuous batching config misfired with sudden query shape change (many long prompts). Reverting recent config change from 2143654200: `batching.max_seq_len=4096` -> revert to 1024.

leo: rolling back batching config now:
```
kubectl -n runtime set env daemonset/serving-runtime BATCH_MAX_SEQ=1024
```

ops-bot: Rollback applied @2143654358. Pods will restart gradually.

maya: p99 down to 1.1s now. Keep monitoring. Leave fallback-model in place for another 5m.

PagerDuty: Reminder: escalation will proceed if alert not acknowledged by secondary in 15m.

sre-rotation: handing off to next on-call @alex for monitoring while I sleep. Ping if p99 >1.3s.

alex: taking over. I'll open a quick dashboard and set temporary alert throttle to reduce pager flapping:
```
./alerts mute --id LATENCY_SLO_BURN --duration 900
```

nina: customers ops notified via status page: `Incident: Increased inference latencies - mitigated, routing fallback active.`

maya: tracking post-incident follow-up: add workload prompt shaper and modify batching heuristics. I'll create a ticket.

alex: thanks team. Final checks: p99 0.95s, p95 0.45s. Closing PD alert.

PagerDuty: PD-987654: acknowledged by maya, resolved by alex. Incident marked mitigated.

Incident Bot: Incident thread closed. :white_check_mark:
